question: Does joint G/I/C-peptide parameter separation survive a wrong or estimated central C-peptide observation volume, under all other BC-011 conditions?

model.mapping: Run unchanged BC011 at theta[0:3]; C=Q1/(0.0655*volume_scale). Volume changes observation concentration only, never amount states, source, initial amounts, ledgers or G/I. Rate multipliers retain BC011 meaning; dimensional Cp clearance is k3*Vp.
model.unchanged: BC011 horizon240min, 30g gastric load, exact basal G/I and SC input, equilibrium reconditioning, source/baseline assumptions, fixed exchange/action/hepatic parameters, equimolar appearance and native profile

observation.source: Fresh unchanged BC011 observation generation at true volume1; preserve all reference/noise/data arrays exactly
observation.noise: Unchanged BC011 independent additive engineering noise; common realizations and nested schedules; basal G/I exact, basal Cp observed; not empirical assay errors

inference.control: One GI control per regime/schedule/data; no duplication across volume arms. GI has no volume estimate; k3 also unobservable when removal rates unknown.
inference.optimizer: Inherit BC011 bounded weighted least squares, absolute log-coordinate central differences and bounded one-sided three-point differences, step0.001, max_nfev60, tolerances1e-8, two starts
inference.objective: sum(((predicted-observed)/fixed channel SD)^2); report per-channel sums, bias, bound hits, all starts and best completed start without a fit-quality clinical threshold
inference.sensitivity: Weighted log-parameter Jacobians at theta(first3)=1 and volume anchor0.8,1,1.2 with BC011 difference/solver refinement; estimated-volume arm at truth1; select exact design columns/rows, impose only proven absent GI k3/V columns zero and retain numerical leakage
inference.noiseless_recovery: Correct and estimated-volume GIC and GI observable parameters must recover within1%; fixed-wrong volume fits have no truth-recovery gate. All optimizer/model failures remain failures, inaccurate completed noisy/wrong-volume estimates remain findings.
inference.interpretation: Local ranks with per-design numerical discrepancy, not global/practical identifiability proof. Two noise realizations do not define coverage; bounds do not close uncertainty intervals. No new profiles or human inference.

verification: Execute unchanged BC011 forward gates; compare V1 wrapper to parent at truth and bound corners; unchanged amounts/ledgers/GI and inverse concentration scaling at V0.5,0.8,1.2,1.5; analytic log-volume derivative and basal Sb/(k3 V) identity; parent fit/reference/independent solver errors after volume scaling; same fresh observations; full matrix repeated in new process
failure_policy: Freeze before fitting, never tune bounds/noise/criteria to results. Save every start including partial/failure, inputs, identity, residuals and estimates. Reject incomplete/nonfinite/invalid solver outputs before fitting. No successful complete-matrix report if required files, repeats, numerical gates or correct/estimated-volume noiseless recovery fail.
excluded: new dynamics or modification of historical references
free appearance ratio or Cp exchange rates
physical population model of volume-rate covariance
